# Keeper

> > Keeper is an AI-powered tax filing platform that handles complex taxes for freelancers, contractors, and business owners with intelligent deduction finding and professional review.

Keeper provides comprehensive tax filing solutions across multiple taxpayer scenarios including self-employed, 1099 contractors, W-2 employees, investors, and expats. The platform combines AI-driven deduction discovery with expert CPA review and offers free calculators and resources for tax planning.

## Key Topics

- AI tax assistant
- 1099 contractors
- Self-employed taxes
- Deduction finder
- Tax-professional review
- Quarterly estimated taxes
- Business deductions
- W-2 employees
- S-Corp taxation
- IRS compliance
- Tax amendments
- Expense tracking
- Capital gains and crypto taxes
- Rental property depreciation
- Foreign tax credits

## Tax Filing by Scenario

- [Taxes for 1099 contractors](https://www.keepertax.com/covered-scenarios/1099-contractors): 1099 contractor tax filing with deduction finder and AI tax assistant
- [Taxes for Self-employed](https://www.keepertax.com/covered-scenarios/self-employed): Self-employment tax filing with AI bookkeeping and quarterly payment support
- [Taxes for W-2 employees](https://www.keepertax.com/covered-scenarios/w-2-employees): Keeper's W-2 employee tax filing service with AI deductions and professional review
- [Taxes for Investors](https://www.keepertax.com/covered-scenarios/investors): Investor tax filing for capital gains, crypto taxes, and wash sale rules
- [Taxes for Property managers](https://www.keepertax.com/covered-scenarios/property-managers): Rental property tax filing with depreciation and Augusta rule support
- [Taxes for Homeowners](https://www.keepertax.com/covered-scenarios/homeowners): Homeowner tax filing covering mortgage interest and property tax deductions
- [Taxes for Expats](https://www.keepertax.com/covered-scenarios/expats): Expat tax filing with foreign tax credit and international deduction support
- [Taxes for Retirees](https://www.keepertax.com/covered-scenarios/retirees): Retiree tax filing covering Social Security, IRA withdrawals, and RMDs
- [Taxes for Parents](https://www.keepertax.com/covered-scenarios/parents): Parent tax filing covering child tax credits and education expense deductions
- [Taxes for Students](https://www.keepertax.com/covered-scenarios/students): Student tax filing with education credits and 529 plan deduction support
- [Taxes for Late filers](https://www.keepertax.com/covered-scenarios/late-filers): Back tax and late filer service with IRS penalty reduction support
- [Taxes for Amendments](https://www.keepertax.com/covered-scenarios/amendments): Tax return amendment filing with AI assistant and professional review

## Tax Calculators & Planning Tools

- [1099 Tax Calculator](https://www.keepertax.com/1099-tax-calculator): Free 1099 tax calculator for self-employed income estimation and quarterly planning
- [Self-Employment Tax Rate Calculator](https://www.keepertax.com/self-employment-tax-rate-calculator): Self-employment tax calculator for freelancers to estimate annual tax savings
- [Quarterly Tax Calculator](https://www.keepertax.com/quarterly-tax-calculator): Free quarterly tax calculator for estimated tax payments and withholding planning
- [Free Tax Resources](https://www.keepertax.com/free-resources): Free tax resources including calculators, tools, and guides for self-employed
